title: Burbank + Joshua Tree · Hollywood & Full-Moon Adventure — February 2027

packing: Scramble kit: grippy approach shoes, flexible pants, tape and small first-aid kit; Joshua Tree granite is abrasive.
Winter desert layers: puffy, shell, warm hat and gloves for freezing/windy dawn and night sessions.
Photo kit: tripod, intervalometer, fast wide lens, telephoto and spare batteries kept warm.
Car kit: offline NPS map, water for everyone, headlamps and a full fuel tank before entering.

days.heading: Pittsburgh → Phoenix → Burbank + Hollywood
days.feel: A little Hollywood, then an easy hotel night
days.daycost: Booked hotel $273.22 · meals and sightseeing parking extra
days.note: Arrival afternoon, all times Pacific: land at 11:59 a.m.; allow time for bags and the rental-center walk. The 12:30 p.m. Alamo reservation is not a guaranteed departure. Have lunch near the hotel, ask to leave bags, then aim for a short Hollywood visit around 2:30–3:30 p.m. If the kids are still up for it, continue to Griffith around 4:30–6 p.m. for the views and exhibits, then dinner back in Burbank. Hotel check-in starts at 3 p.m.; an early room is not confirmed. Allow roughly 25–60 minutes Burbank → Hollywood and 25–45 minutes Hollywood → Griffith, plus parking time; these are planning estimates, not live traffic. Griffith currently opens noon–10 p.m. on Thursdays. Recheck February hours and choose one attraction if delays or tiredness shorten the day.

spots.cost: Walk of Fame sidewalks and Griffith’s building/grounds are free; sightseeing parking is extra. An optional planetarium show currently costs $40 for your family ($12 × two adults + $8 × two kids aged 8 and 12), additional to the planning total. Official ticket information · checked Oct 8, 2026; recheck before February.
spots.climate: Bring layers for the hilltop after sunset. Treat clear views as a bonus; on a rainy or hazy afternoon, spend more time with Griffith’s indoor exhibits and keep the boulevard walk short.
spots.saveHtml: Save Make Hollywood a 45–60 minute stroll around the Chinese Theatre: compare the kids’ hands with the celebrity imprints when the forecourt is accessible, then find a few favorite names using the official star map. Head to Griffith only if everyone still has energy; its terraces give you city and Hollywood Sign views without a long hike.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Choose one extra: a 30-minute Chinese Theatre interior tour (check available times and price), or a planetarium show at Griffith. Planetarium tickets are sold on-site for that day only. Keep both optional after the early Pittsburgh start.
spots.restoHtml:
• Bob’s Big Boy — the easy lunch or dinner pick near the hotel: burgers, chicken fingers, spaghetti and milkshakes. 4211 W Riverside Drive.
  • Paty’s Restaurant — another Riverside Drive fallback with burgers, grilled cheese and chicken strips. 10001 Riverside Drive, Toluca Lake; currently open 8 a.m.–9 p.m., daily.
  • The Smoke House — a more leisurely Burbank dinner with old Hollywood atmosphere and garlic cheese bread. 4420 W Lakeside Drive; reserve if you choose this one.
spots.altboxHtml:
• If the flight day catches up with you: lunch, hotel check-in and a short Riverside Drive stroll are enough. Save the energy for Joshua Tree.
  • If you choose just one attraction: pick Griffith for the city panorama, Hollywood Sign views and science exhibits; pick the boulevard for the stars and Chinese Theatre.
  • If traffic or parking is slow: drop the second stop. Driving estimates exclude the search for a space, and sunset is a busy time at Griffith.
  • If rain spoils the views: Griffith’s free indoor exhibits still work. A paid theatre tour is another option if a departure fits.
  • Movie-studio alternative: Warner Bros. Studio Tour takes about three hours. It would replace the Hollywood/Griffith afternoon; confirm a February departure time before booking. The studio photos show optional experiences, and specific backlots depend on production access. No tour is booked.

spots.cost: All stops are covered by the park pass. Arch Rock is now a 1.4-mile route from Twin Tanks; White Tank is not the public trailhead.
spots.climate: Start early and carry layers. The Cholla Garden has almost no shade, and detached cactus joints can puncture shoes and skin—stay on the path and never touch.
spots.saveHtml: Save Pack lunch and use the free roadside hikes and overlooks.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Spend on the climbing guide, not another tour; this scenic drive is strongest self-guided.
spots.restoHtml:

  • Vons Yucca Valley — full grocery and familiar-food fallback

days.note: Pack Monday night. Plan to leave the Airbnb around 9 a.m., adjusting once its exact address is available, allowing roughly 1–1.5 hours to Palm Springs plus fuel. Keep this morning free of park stops and go straight to the next gate in Phoenix.
